title: Courgette - Spiced Chutney Recipe
preamble:
Makes 1kg - Ready in 2 hours

2 onions , chopped

500g tomatoes, chopped

500g courgettes, diced

300ml white wine vinegar
ingredients: 2 Granny Smith apples, peeled and diced
method: Put all the ingredients in a large pan.
Bring slowly to a simmer, stirring to stop the mixture sticking.
Simmer, uncovered, for 2 hours until dark, thick and chutney-like.
Pour into sterilised jars and leave for 2-3 weeks before eating.
details: Category: Condiments, Jams, Preserves, Pickles and Sauces
